## Instructions

1. Beat the butter, sugar, syrup, egg, vanilla and salt together.
2. Put a few raisins in each shell and fill 2/3 full.
3. Bake at 425 °F on the bottom rack for 15 to 18 minutes, till the filling bubbles.

## Notes

"Runny is right. Firm means you overbaked them." Card also says "Crown syrup" in the method.
